subject.title: Feature: durable natural-language rule learning + explicit multi-mention reply semantics

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class durable conversational rule-governance layer and cross-channel explicit multi-bot mention semantics, or keep the work split across Skill Workshop, memory plugins, and channel-specific fixes?
rationale: The request crosses memory authority, persisted rule storage, workspace-file precedence, plugin boundaries, and channel delivery behavior, and current main has useful partial mechanisms but no settled product contract for the proposed layer.

options.title: Keep As Design Tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers define rule authority, storage, conflict precedence, and channel mention semantics before implementation.

options.title: Split Remaining Work
options.body: Treat Skill Workshop and memory plugins as the durable-learning path, keep Feishu message-loss in its narrower trackers, and open a smaller rule-governance RFC only if maintainers want it.

options.title: Route To Plugin/API Design
options.body: Require the durable rule-learning capability to prove it cannot be built through memory, wiki, skill, or plugin APIs before adding core rule-layer surface.

recommendation.title: Keep As Design Tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers define rule authority, storage, conflict precedence, and channel mention semantics before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the best current-main routing candidate from the available provenance because recent blame and release history cover the relevant memory and Feishu surfaces.
